cards.answer: Mel is a mage/support with AP-scaling magic damage. She builds Overwhelm through repeated hits and can strike marked enemies regardless of distance with her ultimate. Her barrier can reflect enemy champion projectiles.
cards.counterplay: Avoid prolonged trades and hold key projectiles while her barrier is active.

cards.answer: Ability casts add bonus magic-damage projectiles to Mel's next basic attack. Her damaging attacks and abilities apply Overwhelm stacks, which store magic damage and refresh on further hits. When the stored damage exceeds the target's current health and shields, the next stack consumes the stacks to deal that damage.
cards.counterplay: Disengage to let Overwhelm expire; avoid extended trades when low on health.

cards.answer: Rebuttal briefly grants Mel a shield and movement speed. Its barrier intercepts enemy champion projectiles and can send copies back toward their source, with copied damage converted to magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Hold key projectiles until the barrier ends, then look to pressure her.

cards.answer: Solar Snare fires an orb that deals magic damage and roots enemies it hits. The surrounding field expands after a delay, slowing enemies and dealing repeated magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the orb and move away from its surrounding field.

cards.answer: Golden Eclipse requires an enemy champion marked with Overwhelm to cast. It strikes all Overwhelm-marked enemies regardless of distance, dealing magic damage that increases with their stacks and briefly revealing them. Its ranks also increase Overwhelm's stored damage.
cards.counterplay: Break contact early to let marks expire; do not rely on distance alone while marked.
